description: Decode and MTP-verify steps of GLM-5.3 at tensor parallelism 8 (SGLang widths 2, 4, 8; MTP verifies 4-token chains). Contexts are AgentX decode-step-weighted quantiles (semianalysisai/cc-traces-weka-062126, derived from corpus statistics, not yet confirmed by a live capture); other requests of a step hold ctx/2..ctx. Three compiled widths (2, 4, 8) keep the FlyDSL compile budget; prefill does not apply (the monokernel serves decode and verify only).
